judge_panel.reasoning: The reviewer report contains no mention of Håstad's E3SAT theorem, the 7/8 threshold, the 15/16 value, or hastad2001optimal. None of the three findings address this citation or its numerical claim.

The review contains no discussion of Håstad, E3SAT, Appendix A.1, or the 7/8 versus 15/16 threshold. None of the findings challenge the cited source or quoted value as required for a numeric citation misquote.
The reviewer focuses exclusively on mathematical derivations in Sections 4.2 and 4.4. There is no mention of the E3SAT threshold, the Hastad (2001) paper, or the value 15/16.
The reviewer report makes no mention of bootstrap experiments, the number of bootstrap products, or any discrepancy between 50,000 and 5,000. None of the findings address this numeric inconsistency.

The reviewer does not mention the bootstrap experiment, Appendix D.3, Section 6.1, or the number of bootstrap products (5,000 vs 50,000). All findings concern proof derivations in Sections 4.2 and 4.4 instead.
The reviewer does not mention the bootstrap experiment, the product count, or the discrepancy between the main text (50,000) and the appendix (5,000).

The reviewer's findings focus on arithmetic and constant derivations in Section 4.4 and 4.2, not on the index mismatch in Eq. (5) where summation variable j references an unbound index i in h_{C,i}(x). No finding specifically flags this structural index error.

Although the review flags mathematical issues, they are about incorrect constants and inequalities in concentration bounds, not the unbound index i in Eq. (5). There is no mention of the network output equation or an index/summation mismatch.
The reviewer's findings relate to Equations 12, 13, 17, 18, and 19. There is no mention of Equation 5 or the index mismatch (j vs i) injected into it.
None of the reviewer's findings mention the unsupported parenthetical about a preliminary scan showing large discretization artifacts for B < 16, nor the choice of B=16 in Section 6.1.

The report does not mention Section 6.1, the choice B=16, or the unsupported parenthetical about a preliminary scan and discretization artifacts. No finding corresponds to this phantom-evidence methodological justification.
